title: 29 CFR 1910.1200 — Hazard Communication
notes: Authoritative U.S. federal general-industry Hazard Communication standard. Applicability and employer obligations must be interpreted in the actual workplace/jurisdiction. Course 1 teaches durable worker-level HazCom behaviors while facility training must track the active OSHA transition schedule.

hazcomTransition.courseUse: Use current workplace labels, SDS information, employer HazCom program, task procedure and required PPE; escalate missing or conflicting information. Transition dates are maintenance metadata, not learner memorization targets.
